title: Auth — Passkey Login (finish)
description: Submit the WebAuthn assertion that completes a passkey login or step-up ceremony. On success the auth service issues a session (login) or elevates an existing session's acr (step-up).

authId.description: The authId issued by the matching login/start response. Echoed verbatim.

credential.description: AuthenticatorAssertionResponse as returned by `navigator.credentials.get`. Binary fields base64url-encoded.

Response.title: Auth Passkey Login Finish — response payload
Response.description: Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/auth/passkey/login/finish/0.1#response. For `purpose: login` the payload includes the new session + tokens; for `purpose: step-up` only the elevated session is included (the producer's existing tokens are unchanged — they now carry a higher acr at the next token introspection).

tokens.description: Present when `purpose: login` (a new session). Absent for `stepUp` — the producer's existing tokens remain valid and now carry the elevated acr.
